title: Phone voice input never sends on a pause: it waits for the word send or a tap, everywhere

requirements.text: In every place the phone listens (questions, updates with no question, replies), it keeps recording through pauses and sends only when TJ says send or taps the button; no timed silence cutoff anywhere
requirements.check: On a no-question update and on a question, speak with long pauses: nothing sends until 'send' or the button

fields.symptom: After a plain update, TJ's words were taken as his answer at the first pause and the walk moved on, losing the rest of what he said
fields.root_cause: Walker.listen used a one-shot SpeechRecognizer with a 2.5s silence cutoff for updates, and handle() took whatever it had at the cutoff as the full answer. Only the answer sheet (questions) used the pause-proof Dictation + SpokenSend path.
whys: Two listening paths were built at different times with different send rules: the walk's own recognizer predates the send-word rule
The send-word rule was added to the answer sheet and the walk path was never moved onto it
fields.corrective: Words after an update that do not end in send open the answer sheet, seeded with them, whose mic keeps listening until send or a tap (WalkPlan.saidOnPause, Walker.hold). The main chat mic gains spoken send with the same countdown and Cancel.
fields.preventive: WalkPlanTest: words without send on a pause are Unsent, never Reply

text: Fixed in code: an update's words without 'send' open the answer sheet seeded with them (keeps listening through pauses); words ending in send go; main chat mic has spoken send + Cancel bar. 44 unit tests pass, APK builds. Mac Focus Mode never listens, so not affected. Left: TJ's car/Pixel check.
Shipped in 0.1.457319 (built from 7544baa-equivalent tree, R2 link checked online). Not installed on any phone. Left: TJ installs from the link and checks.
